description: DOT (Graphviz) conformance corpus: Graphviz tests/graphs, issue reproductions, regression and gallery files (EPL-2.0, test-only), pydot, ts-graphviz and graphlib-dot parser cases (MIT), and authored cases for encodings, comments, multiple graphs and syntax errors. Expectations come from Graphviz 2.43 gvpr (tools/oracle_dot.py) or, where graph-io is meant to differ from Graphviz, from sources.md section 5.4. graph-io models every cluster subgraph as one extra container node (parent column), so the expected node count is Graphviz's node count plus the distinct cluster subgraphs, minus a cluster that shares its name with a node (the two merge); edges are Graphviz's edge count. For a file with several graphs the counts are those of the first graph and 'graphs' is how many importAllGraphs() returns.
